units: <cite ref="Yoma 42b:9">Yoma 42ᵇ</cite> <he>כל הפרשה כולה משמע מוציא מיד משמע ומשמע ממ׳</he> in that section (<cite ref="Numbers 19">Num. XIX</cite>) there are texts intimating an exception from a preceding intimation, and texts independent of preceding or following intimations.
